title.zh: 一笔订单，为什么需要三种一致性约束？
title.en: Why one order needs three consistency rules

summary.zh: 从丝路智链的教学订单出发，区分重复请求、库存竞争和状态推进，整理可以验证的工程判断。
summary.en: Use a Silk Road teaching order to distinguish request retries, stock contention and state transitions, then turn those distinctions into testable decisions.

basis.zh: 依据已公开的源码审阅笔记与既有验证清单整理；示例为教学归纳。本次笔记整理未运行原后端或并发测试。
basis.en: Based on the published source-review note and historical verification inventory. Examples are teaching summaries; the original backend and concurrency tests were not run for this note.

paragraphs.zh: 下单超时后，客户无法判断服务端是否已提交。重试可能重复扣库存；两位客户又可能同时购买最后一件商品。这是不同问题：前者需要识别同一意图，后者需要保护共享库存。按钮防连点只能改善操作体验。
paragraphs.en: After a checkout timeout, a customer cannot tell whether the server committed the order. Retrying may reserve stock twice, while two customers may compete for the last item. These are separate problems: one requires recognizing the same intent; the other requires protecting shared stock. Disabling repeated clicks only improves the interaction.

bullets.zh: 相同意图重试，订单和库存变化只发生一次。
bullets.en: Retrying the same intent creates one order and one stock reservation.

bullets.zh: 库存不能为负；非法状态不能推进。
bullets.en: Stock cannot become negative, and invalid state transitions must be rejected.

title.zh: 02 / 幂等键必须和内容绑定
title.en: 02 / Bind an idempotency key to its content

paragraphs.zh: 已有审阅记录显示，createOrder 按学院、用户和 requestId 查找订单，并对规范化业务内容计算摘要。相同标识、相同内容返回旧订单；相同标识却改变数量会被拒绝。因此，幂等键不只是缓存命中的开关，也是请求意图的契约。
paragraphs.en: The existing review records that createOrder looks up an order by college, user and requestId, then compares a digest of normalized business content. The same key and content return the existing order; changing the quantity under that key is rejected. The key therefore represents an agreement about intent, rather than merely a cache lookup.

code.text:
Teaching sequence (synthetic identifiers)
A: requestId=r-01, items=[{productId:7, quantity:1}]
A retry: same key + same content -> existing order
A changed: same key + quantity:2 -> reject conflict
B: another user + r-01 -> a separate scoped request

callout.zh: 以上为行为示意，不是可直接调用的接口报文。重试应沿用原请求标识；新的购买意图需要新标识。
callout.en: This is a behavior sketch, not a directly callable API payload. A retry should preserve the original key; a new purchase intent needs a new key.

title.zh: 03 / 事务保护的是一组业务事实
title.en: 03 / A transaction protects a set of business facts

paragraphs.zh: 源码审阅笔记描述了 READ_COMMITTED 事务、商品按 ID 升序加锁，以及取得锁后再次检查既有请求。等待锁的请求可能在这段时间变成重复提交，所以第一次检查不够。总价采用数据库单价和 BigDecimal；订单快照、库存预留与创建事件一起提交。
paragraphs.en: The source-review note describes a READ_COMMITTED transaction, product locks acquired in ascending ID order, and a second existing-request check after locking. A waiting request may become a duplicate while another transaction finishes, so the first check is insufficient. Database prices and BigDecimal determine totals; the order snapshot, stock reservation and creation event commit together.

paragraphs.zh: 统一加锁顺序减少锁顺序反转，代价是竞争商品仍会等待。不能由此推断系统没有死锁或已具备高吞吐；超时、回滚和重试策略还需要单独测量。
paragraphs.en: Consistent lock ordering reduces lock-order inversions, but popular products still cause waiting. This does not establish freedom from deadlocks or high throughput; timeouts, rollback and retry policies require separate measurement.

title.zh: 04 / 幂等与状态机各管一件事
title.en: 04 / Idempotency and state machines do different jobs

paragraphs.zh: 任务按 QUEUED → INSPECTING → LOCATING → PICKING → COMPLETED 推进，eventId 识别重复回执，状态约束阻止跳步。失败后显式重试回到队列。两层检查缺一不可：新事件也可能非法，同一事件也不应重复推进。
paragraphs.en: Tasks progress through QUEUED → INSPECTING → LOCATING → PICKING → COMPLETED. An eventId identifies repeated receipts, while state rules prevent skipped stages. An explicit retry returns a failed task to the queue. Both checks matter: a new event may be invalid, and a duplicate event must not advance the task again.

paragraphs.zh: 订单取消同样要检查当前状态；已取消订单再次取消不能重复返还库存。出库和确认收货必须分开，模拟支付成功也不代表真实资金已到账。
paragraphs.en: Cancellation also checks the current order state; cancelling an already cancelled order must not release stock again. Dispatch and receipt remain distinct, and a successful simulated payment does not establish a real transfer of funds.

paragraphs.zh: 适合复查的测试应断言最终订单数、库存和事件数，而不只断言接口返回成功。建议在隔离数据库中固定初始库存，控制两个请求同时到达；失败后也要检查没有残留的半份订单。以下是复查方案，并非本轮执行结果。
paragraphs.en: Useful tests assert final order counts, stock and event counts, rather than only successful responses. A proposed review would use an isolated database, fixed initial stock and synchronized competing requests, then check for partial orders after failure. The cases below are a verification plan, not results from this update.

bullets.zh: 同键同内容并发重试：一个订单、一次扣减；同键改内容：拒绝。
bullets.en: Concurrent identical retries: one order and one reservation. Changed content under the same key: reject.

bullets.zh: 两人争最后一件：最多一笔成功；重复取消：只归还一次。
bullets.en: Two buyers for the last item: at most one succeeds. Repeated cancellation: release stock once.

bullets.zh: 跳过质检、乱序或重放回执：拒绝非法推进或返回已有结果。
bullets.en: Skipped QC, out-of-order receipts and replays: reject invalid advancement or return the existing result.

title.zh: 06 / 结论必须跟随证据范围

paragraphs.zh: 既有清单记录 41 项后端测试通过，其中订单业务 9 项；本次未重跑。原报告未公开，文件哈希只能帮助后续比对，不能替代独立复现。下一步值得补充最小隔离环境、失败注入与锁等待记录，再讨论多节点和外部支付。
paragraphs.en: The historical inventory records 41 passing backend tests, including nine order-workflow tests; none were rerun for this note. The raw reports are not public, so their hashes support later comparison rather than independent reproduction. Useful next steps are a minimal isolated environment, failure injection and lock-wait records before evaluating multiple nodes or external payments.

callout.zh: 项目复用既有学院应用与 vue-next-admin。这里提炼业务改造的判断，不将复用框架或教学仿真描述为个人原创成果或生产验证。
callout.en: The project reuses an existing college application and vue-next-admin. This note extracts decisions from the business adaptation without claiming personal authorship of the reused framework or production validation of the simulation.
